# Kasi Frost project notes

- This is a React + Vite JavaScript project. Follow existing patterns and keep changes focused.
- Product content and editable sample ZAR prices live in `src/data/products.js`.
- Keep adult drink concepts separate from family-friendly products. Concepts are not available to order. A checkbox is not age or identity verification.
- The cart and contact form are front-end previews only. Do not claim messages are sent or payments/orders are processed.
- Do not add real business contact details, product ingredients, partnerships, or confirmed prices unless supplied by the owner.
- Run `npm run build` after changes when Node.js dependencies are installed.
